title: Commercial Credit Memo
description: Commercial Credit Memo contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-commercial-credit-memo
  title: Commercial Credit Memo
  description: Commercial Credit Memo contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_commercial_credit_memo_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/commercial_credit_memo
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/commercial_credit_memo
    sourceVersion: fs_commercial_credit_memo_v1
    sourceDigest: f69aeabef8aa1425f0b55c597a3e7b745d86da93cc719ddb5799f813887b7106
spec:
  documentType: commercial_credit_memo
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - memo-date
        - next-review-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - covenant-summary
        - facility-type
        - guarantor-summary
        - leverage-ratio
        - liquidity-summary
        - ltv-percent
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - loan-purpose
        - proposed-commitment-amount
        - risk-rating-current
        - total-exposure-amount
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - policy-exceptions
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - borrower-industry
        - borrower-name
        - relationship-manager-name
        - underwriter-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collateral-summary
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - approval-authority
        - approval-conditions
        - approval-status
        - debt-service-coverage-ratio
        - probability-of-default
        - risk-rating-proposed
  fields:
    - id: memo-date
      name: memo_date
      label: Memo Date
      description: Credit memo date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/memo_date
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower or obligor name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: borrower-industry
      name: borrower_industry
      label: Borrower Industry
      description: Industry or NAICS description.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_industry
    - id: relationship-manager-name
      name: relationship_manager_name
      label: Relationship Manager Name
      description: RM, banker, or officer.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/relationship_manager_name
    - id: underwriter-name
      name: underwriter_name
      label: Underwriter Name
      description: Credit analyst or underwriter.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/underwriter_name
    - id: facility-type
      name: facility_type
      label: Facility Type
      description: Term loan, revolver, CRE, equipment, SBA, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/facility_type
    - id: proposed-commitment-amount
      name: proposed_commitment_amount
      label: Proposed Commitment Amount
      description: Proposed loan or commitment amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/proposed_commitment_amount
    - id: total-exposure-amount
      name: total_exposure_amount
      label: Total Exposure Amount
      description: Total borrower relationship exposure after approval.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/total_exposure_amount
    - id: loan-purpose
      name: loan_purpose
      label: Loan Purpose
      description: Use of proceeds.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/loan_purpose
    - id: collateral-summary
      name: collateral_summary
      label: Collateral Summary
      description: Collateral package summary.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_summary
    - id: guarantor-summary
      name: guarantor_summary
      label: Guarantor Summary
      description: Guarantor support summary.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/guarantor_summary
    - id: risk-rating-current
      name: risk_rating_current
      label: Risk Rating Current
      description: Existing risk rating.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/risk_rating_current
    - id: risk-rating-proposed
      name: risk_rating_proposed
      label: Risk Rating Proposed
      description: Proposed risk rating.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/risk_rating_proposed
    - id: probability-of-default
      name: probability_of_default
      label: Probability Of Default
      description: PD if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/probability_of_default
    - id: debt-service-coverage-ratio
      name: debt_service_coverage_ratio
      label: Debt Service Coverage Ratio
      description: DSCR.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/debt_service_coverage_ratio
    - id: leverage-ratio
      name: leverage_ratio
      label: Leverage Ratio
      description: Debt/EBITDA, debt/equity, or leverage ratio as stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/leverage_ratio
    - id: ltv-percent
      name: ltv_percent
      label: Ltv Percent
      description: Loan-to-value percent.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/ltv_percent
    - id: liquidity-summary
      name: liquidity_summary
      label: Liquidity Summary
      description: Liquidity or cash flow narrative.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/liquidity_summary
    - id: covenant-summary
      name: covenant_summary
      label: Covenant Summary
      description: Financial or reporting covenants.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/covenant_summary
    - id: policy-exceptions
      name: policy_exceptions
      label: Policy Exceptions
      description: Credit policy exceptions.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_exceptions
    - id: approval-authority
      name: approval_authority
      label: Approval Authority
      description: Committee, officer, or authority approving.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_authority
    - id: approval-status
      name: approval_status
      label: Approval Status
      description: Approved, declined, conditional, recommended, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_status
    - id: approval-conditions
      name: approval_conditions
      label: Approval Conditions
      description: Conditions to close or fund.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/approval_conditions
    - id: next-review-date
      name: next_review_date
      label: Next Review Date
      description: Next annual review or monitoring date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/next_review_date
  validationRules:
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Credit memo must identify the borrower.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: commitment-amount-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Proposed commitment amount cannot be zero or negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: proposed_commitment_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: proposed_commitment_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: proposed_commitment_amount IS NULL OR proposed_commitment_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: risk-rating-present
      severity: warning
      description: Credit memos should include current or proposed risk rating.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: risk_rating_proposed
          - op: present
            field: risk_rating_current
      sourceExpression: risk_rating_proposed IS NOT NULL OR risk_rating_current IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: approval-status-present
      severity: warning
      description: Approval status is needed to determine memo outcome.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: approval_status
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: approval_status
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: approval_status IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(approval_status)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: policy-exceptions-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Policy exceptions should be captured as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: policy_exceptions
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: policy_exceptions
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: policy_exceptions IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(policy_exceptions) >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrower identity must align with the credit file.
      proposed_commitment_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Commitment amount controls approval authority and exposure.
      risk_rating_proposed:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Risk rating is a regulated credit monitoring and allowance input.
      approval_status:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Approval status determines whether the memo is actionable.
      policy_exceptions:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Policy exceptions should be reviewable by credit administration.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Credit memos contain narrative underwriting, ratios, exceptions, risk ratings, and approval
      conditions that require careful clause-level extraction.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      memo_date:
        type: date
        description: Credit memo date.
        format: date
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower or obligor name.
      borrower_industry:
        type: string
        description: Industry or NAICS description.
      relationship_manager_name:
        type: string
        description: RM, banker, or officer.
      underwriter_name:
        type: string
        description: Credit analyst or underwriter.
      facility_type:
        type: string
        description: Term loan, revolver, CRE, equipment, SBA, or other.
      proposed_commitment_amount:
        type: number
        description: Proposed loan or commitment amount.
      total_exposure_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total borrower relationship exposure after approval.
      loan_purpose:
        type: string
        description: Use of proceeds.
      collateral_summary:
        type: string
        description: Collateral package summary.
      guarantor_summary:
        type: string
        description: Guarantor support summary.
      risk_rating_current:
        type: string
        description: Existing risk rating.
      risk_rating_proposed:
        type: string
        description: Proposed risk rating.
      probability_of_default:
        type: number
        description: PD if stated.
      debt_service_coverage_ratio:
        type: number
        description: DSCR.
      leverage_ratio:
        type: number
        description: Debt/EBITDA, debt/equity, or leverage ratio as stated.
      ltv_percent:
        type: number
        description: Loan-to-value percent.
      liquidity_summary:
        type: string
        description: Liquidity or cash flow narrative.
      covenant_summary:
        type: string
        description: Financial or reporting covenants.
      policy_exceptions:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Credit policy exceptions.
      approval_authority:
        type: string
        description: Committee, officer, or authority approving.
      approval_status:
        type: string
        description: Approved, declined, conditional, recommended, or other.
      approval_conditions:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Conditions to close or fund.
      next_review_date:
        type: date
        description: Next annual review or monitoring date.
        format: date
    required:
      - borrower_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - borrower_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
